documents.unit: Junta de Gobierno, Universidad de Puerto Rico (system-wide, applies to Mayagüez)
documents.title: Política de Uso de Inteligencia Artificial en la Universidad de Puerto Rico (Certificación 66, 2024-2025)
documents.summary: System-wide regulation of the University of Puerto Rico Board (Certification 66, 2025) that sets principles, governance and responsibilities for AI in administration, teaching and research. For students it allows AI only when professors authorize it and treats unauthorized AI use in assessments as academic dishonesty; instructors must put AI rules in every syllabus. Most of the text covers data security, vendor review, IP and oversight bodies.
documents.stance_why: The policy lets "El estudiantado podrá utilizar IA ... siempre que sea autorizado por sus profesores" and bans substituting intellectual effort with AI in assessments "a menos que el profesor haya impartido instrucciones explícitas", so it sets no uniform rule and leaves the decision to each instructor, who must state it in the syllabus. I coded delegates, though it reads as restrict-unless-authorized for students.

notes: Spanish-language system-wide regulation. Mostly institutional governance; few student-facing rules (Art. VII.B.2-4). Doc stance coded delegates because student AI use depends on professor authorization; restrict is arguable. Military-AI ban unit is UNCOVERED. Topic codes follow those seen in other coder outputs; AGENT_BRIEF.md was not found.
